card.name: Needle size and length in injection instructions
card.fires_on: The space, the letter x, or the number just before a needle length or gauge in injection instructions, such as 'gauge x 0.5-inch' or '21G x 5/8" needle'. It also fires on numbers for filter pore size or injection depth.

modes.label: Gauge-by-length
modes.description: The 'x' or the space after it, between needle gauge and needle length.

modes.label: Space before needle size
modes.description: The space just before a needle gauge or length number.

modes.label: Other device measures
modes.description: A number giving a filter pore size or injection depth or angle.
